IRS990.Desc: SMALL BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT CENTER THAT PROVIDES NO-COST ADVISING AND CONSULTING SERVICES TO ENTREPRENEURS AND SMALL BUSINESSES

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: In partnership with the Asian Business Association Foundation, AAPI Data, and the California Commission on Asian and Pacific Islander American Affairs, ABASD conducted a California-statewide research initiativecomprising a comprehensive economic and small business study of AANHPI-owned enterprises, designed to thoroughly examine the AANHPI business community across the state and assess how current issues are affecting their operations and growth in order to provide better services and programs.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: In conjunction with the Asian Business Association Foundations multi-year contract for installing the Convoy Pan Asian Cultural and Business Innovation District sign in the City of San Diego, ABASD contributed its leadership and membership expertise to help cultivate the district into a thriving regional destination with the ultimate goal of growing the local economy for the benefit of all.
